decision.reason: [ev-19ebf0fc97cf] is a single CLI changelog line. It says that support for a custom storage namespace was added when creating a HelmRelease, but it doesn't name the CLI command, flag or field that implements it, so the subject can't be identified. It also gives no preconditions or effect on existing configurations, so there is nothing to build an applicability condition from. It only points to PR #5534. We need that PR or the CLI reference for the HelmRelease create command, showing the exact flag name and how it behaves.
